verdict.rationale: Claude Code's own docs position it to 'build, debug, and ship', debug live web apps via Chrome, accept piped logs, run overnight CI failure analysis, turn a Slack bug report into a PR, run tests, and 'verify it works'. These are mostly headline-level claims rather than a documented reproduce/root-cause/verify workflow. A hands-on user also reports that its self-verification cannot be trusted, which weakens the verification claim without contradicting the documented debugging capability. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of issue reproduction and root-cause narrowing workflows, independent corroboration that fix verification is reliable.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes
